messages:
raj: Quick sync — running a cross-team snapshot for the Optimize toolkit delivery. Need: milestone dates, explicit owners for the quant recommendations, batching/caching PRs, and any regression alerts. Can owners reply with current status?

alex: I'm owner for batching improvements. On track for a canary rollout Wed. CI green; perf +7% p50 but saw memory bump on long sequences. PR: https://git.internal/r/1234 — would love a quick perf eyeball.

sophia: I'm on quant recs. Draft doc uploaded: /docs/quant-recs-v2.md. Want reviews from eng-ml + infra before we finalize. Blocking infra change: kv-cache TTL semantics need a tiny tweak (see below). ETA next Tue for final recs.

tess: Noting a regression alert — A/B shows ~1.8% drop in rerank accuracy when using 4-bit int8 quant on the candidate model. Repro steps in the eval notebook. Marking as P1; we should pause any automatic rollout until we root cause.

devops-bot: Deploy monitor triggered: model-serving-prod latency spike 2026-03-15T14:12:05Z — p95 increased from 180ms -> 420ms for short requests. Linked incident: INC-5821.

alex: Looking at kernel queues — we see a batching spike where queue depth jumps. Added telemetry flag. Temp mitigation: reducing batch cap to 16. Running a canary with reduced cap now.

raj: Can we confirm owners for the delivery lanes? batching: alex; quant recs: sophia; cache/tiering + rollout gates: tess. Dependencies: infra (liam) needs to merge kv-cache TTL change. Liam, can you ack and give ETA?

liam: Ack. I see the TTL change in the infra queue. I'll prioritize and aim to ship today. Will ping when the prod config is rolled.

sophia: FYI on the regression: holding recommendations until we validate fallback heuristics. Also added an eval set for rerank to s3: s3://redwood-eval/optkit/rerank/seed-v2 — use that for consistent comparisons.

tess: Added a canary gate to the rollout config: `canary: {pct:5, metrics: ['rerank_accuracy','latency_p95']}` and a regression alert rule for >1% accuracy drop. Will wire the alert to the oncall channel.

raj: Quick ask: PR review blockers? alex/sophia/tess please list any CRs needing attention.

alex: Need @devex-team review on `batcher.cpp` change. PR 1234. If perf team can scan the latency flamegraphs that would help.

sophia: PR 1256 for quant profiles needs two reviewers from eng-ml. Tagging @eng-ml for review. Tests added: quant_profile_unit and accuracy_regression.

tess: No CR blockers from my side, just waiting on the kv-cache TTL merge to flip a flag.

raj: OK — I'll consolidate into the delivery doc and update milestones. One more: can we do a 15m async check-in tomorrow morning? Reply with OK if you can.

alex: OK :thumbsup:

sophia: ok for me

tess: +1

liam: ok, may be on a short infra rollout but should hop in if needed

devops-bot: Scheduled reminder: 2026-03-16T09:00:00Z created by raj for channel eng-platform.

alex: quick debug command I ran: `kubectl logs -l app=model-serving -n prod | grep 'queue-depth' | tail -n 100` — looks like the high queue-depth aligns with an upstream traffic burst.

sophia: action items I have: finish quant doc, run eval on s3 seed-v2, hold final recommendation pending fallback validation.

tess: action items: add canary gate (done), wire regression alert (in progress), coordinate with liam to flip TTL flag once merged.

raj: Thanks all — I'll update the delivery tracker and ping stakeholders. If the regression crosses 2% we'll open a formal incident. Otherwise keep this thread for status updates.
